cultural_norms.title: Religious & Sacred Spaces
cultural_norms.guideline: Modest attire covering shoulders and knees is mandatory at Sri Aurobindo Ashram, temples, and churches. Footwear must be removed before entering ashram courtyards and sanctums.

cultural_norms.title: Photography Protocol
cultural_norms.guideline: Photography is strictly forbidden inside Sri Aurobindo Ashram courtyard and samadhi. Street photography in White Town is welcomed, but respect private residential doorways.

cultural_norms.title: Promenade Beach Vehicle Restrictions
cultural_norms.guideline: Promenade Beach road is completely closed to motorized vehicles every evening from 6:00 PM to 7:30 AM the next morning, creating a pristine pedestrian-only zone.

cultural_norms.title: Eco-Conscious Tourism & Waste
cultural_norms.guideline: Puducherry enforces strict single-use plastic bans across heritage zones and beaches. Carry a reusable water bottle; filtered water refill stations are present in White Town cafés.

electrical_specs.plug_types: Type C, D, and M (Standard Indian three-pin round and two-pin European round)
electrical_specs.adapter_note: Universal surge-protected travel adapter recommended for UK (Type G) and US (Type A/B) travelers.

local_transport_tips.tip: White Town is flat and compact (1.5 km²); renting a vintage bicycle or electric bicycle is the most carbon-free and scenic way to explore.
Agree on fares before boarding or ask for standard meter rates (approx ₹50 base for short local rides in town).
